digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture teardown and snapshot cleanup
propositions: macOS CI cleanup fails after snapshot tests complete because .rebar/run_snapshots subdirectories retain non-writable 0444/0555 permissions and cannot be removed by standard shutil.rmtree
snapshot-producing tests outside tests/unit/workflow/test_snapshot.py leave non-removable .rebar/run_snapshots trees because teardown was only implemented in the module-local fixture
shared pytest teardown in tests/conftest.py now owns cleanup of all .rebar/run_snapshots roots below each test-owned tmp_path using the existing snapshot._rmtree_writable permission-restoration seam
production snapshot read-only permissions must be preserved during test execution while being stripped during shared pytest teardown to allow basetemp removal
adjacent temporary files created by tests must survive shared teardown without modification
